pages.title: Antithrombotic Therapy
pages.scope: Full original MDX including all tables, practical instructions and bibliography read. Primary-source verification and corrections underway.
notes: Incorrect no-hold UFH neuraxial instruction; generic 12-hour LMWH postoperative/catheter rule misses regimen differences.
POISE-2 interpretation reversed; PATCH was spontaneous intracerebral hemorrhage, not ischemic stroke.
Routine bridge indications conflict with CHEST 2022 and overgeneralize PERIOP2; postoperative versus preoperative design and excluded valves must be distinguished.
28 days after discharge should be procedure-specific duration counted from surgery; procedure risks/table combine unverified contexts and Caprini recommendations are not a universal urologic mandate.
Current antithrombin labeling and heparin-resistance/sepsis evidence require source checks; odds ratio is not a 66% mortality risk reduction.

pages.title: Pulmonary Embolism
pages.scope: Full original MDX including all tables, practical instructions and bibliography read. Primary-source verification and corrections underway.
notes: 2026 guideline is cited but new A–E classification and one-week follow-up are missing.
Postoperative low D-dimer absolute 2-week prohibition, automatic day-7 DOAC transition, blanket GI-cancer exclusion and routine recurrent-PE filter indication need correction.
Thrombolysis effect from mixed trial populations mislabeled high-risk-only; catheter thrombolysis still carries bleeding risk after surgery.
Active cancer mislabeled strong transient factor; persistent risk factor versus unprovoked conflated; CTEPH hemodynamic definition incomplete.
High-yield HI-PEITHO 2026 544-patient randomized trial missing; obtain full main trial and exclusion criteria before adding scoped summary.

pages.title: Steroids
pages.scope: Full original MDX including all tables, practical instructions and bibliography read. Primary-source verification and corrections underway.
notes: Current 2024 HPA suppression dose/duration and recovery-testing thresholds conflict with existing categories; chronic low-dose and inhaled-risk statements are too absolute.
Guideline Table 8 stress coverage applies to adrenal-insufficiency risk, not every steroid user; avoid double-counting usual dose and indefinite NPO 200 mg.
Unverified universal BMG/prosthesis prednisone dose cutoffs, chronic IC steroid framing, and assured stress hydrocortisone antiemesis require correction.
Postoperative 2–3x baseline oral regimen is not the cited Table 8 scheme and may lower a high baseline; crisis hyperkalemia applies primarily mineralocorticoid-deficient disease.
